description: Default colour roles of Schematix (memory/hub/schematix_style.md). Sasha tunes them in the app (key c); his values live in data/schematix/palette.json. Three kinds by name: `surface-*` is the ground of a plane (measured: `dim` text on it), `texture-*` the quiet pattern on that plane (measured against its surface, decoration, no floor), every other role is light/text measured against `board`. Text roles and surfaces must reach 4.5:1 (measured, never corrected).
